description: Read school facts, processing priority, campuses, dates and linked RTO. includeEvidence explicitly requests school evidence levels and optional passport-country risk/checklist facts; default false. On the public endpoint evidence requires a website account. The internal API-key endpoint can read it directly. No passport or student category is assumed. locale selects website links. This public endpoint returns English natural-language text, preserving sources, conditions and pagination.

includeEvidence.description: Explicitly read provider evidence, independent of the selected public sections. Website OAuth is required only on the public endpoint.

locale.description: Language of names/descriptions in the result: zh-CN (default, Simplified Chinese plus English names), en-US, zh-TW. Also selects the language prefix of returned oneuedu.com URLs.

passportCountry.description: Passport-country code, with no default; not current residence.

studentType.description: Document Checklist student category. Only 01 is supported for documentary outcomes; no default.

name: get_school
title: Get provider (school) details
